title: Provision S3 Versioning Configuration
scenario: Your platform team needs S3 Versioning Configuration for protecting objects from accidental deletion. Write a reusable Terraform configuration that provisions it, drives every input through variables, applies the standard tags, and exports the operational identifiers.
constraints: Create exactly one resource of type aws_s3_bucket_versioning.
All configurable values must come from variables declared in variables.tf.
Code must pass terraform fmt conventions (2-space indents, trailing newline, no tabs).
